programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, it is now haunted by shadow figures, and they appear to want to make themselves known.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues the investigation at Morley Market and appears to be followed by a spirit person that wants to touch him and distract him from investigating certain parts of the main hall. Will he uncover who this spirit is?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1
programme.desc: Four floors of terror! Objects from around the world are at home in the museum, but what is attached to them, which now roams the floors and corridors after dark?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 2
programme.desc: With activity sending the team into a spin on the top floor, is there something attached to the museum's main attraction, the mummy?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Theme Park - Part 1
programme.desc: What could be haunting an abandoned theme park in Lancashire? Ghost Dimension seek out paranormal activity in Camelot and they are in for a ride!

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Theme Park - Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension continue investigating Camelot Theme Park, the UK's most haunted and come face to face, with a powerful paranormal entity.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Huldra Lene Angelica har trollbundet flere av guttene på hotellet. Maiken lar sjalusien ta overhånd og gjør ting hun ikke burde.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Et viktig valg skal tas og gruppepresset på hotellet har aldri vært større. Det blir temperatur på kveldens parseremoni når sannheter kommer fram i lyset.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Det er afterski på hotellet, det blir både opp- og nedturer når en alpinist rokker om på alle parene. Stemningen er i taket når festen sparkes i gang med en imitasjonskonkurranse.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Det flørtes heftig på festen og en krangel bryter ut før leggetid. Markus og Maiken gjør noe de fort skal få angre på.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Etter en fuktig kveld på afterski brer fylleangsten seg utover hotellet. Et taktisk valg fører til en tårevåt parseremoni. Men er alle tårene ekte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1719
programme.desc: Den sterkeste spilleren på hotellet skal pekes ut og velge sin største rival. Hotellet skal deles inn i to allianser hvor den ene settes i STOR fare.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 903
programme.desc: Hanne kjøpte drømmeboligen som viste seg å være infisert av både rotter og skjeggkre. Etter sitt forrige bomkjøp håper hun at Hans Christian kan hjelpe. Og Christian skal kjøpe sin første leilighet.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 221
programme.desc: Det er en ny uke på Camp Kulinaris, og gruppa lurer på hvem den hjemsendte har valgt som denne ukens Restaurantsjef.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 222
programme.desc: I dag er det menysmaking på Camp Kulinaris og deltakerne er spent på Kjartans tilbakemeldinger på bryllupsmaten de lager.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 223
programme.desc: Det er bryllup på Camp Kulinaris! I dag må alt være perfekt og det er null rom for å feile når gruppa har ansvaret for den største dagen i et ungt pars liv.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 224
programme.desc: I dag må restaurantsjefen velge en lærling som må forsvare plassen sin på Camp Kulinaris. Det blir en jevn og dramatisk lærlingkamp der to deltakere møtes til sudden death.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 225
programme.desc: Det er den siste uken før finaleuken og Kjartan har med den vanskeligste oppgaven som er laget i Camp kulinaris historie.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 226
programme.desc: Det er klart for menysmaking og restaurantsjefen må lede gruppen gjennom den avanserte menyen fra Kjartans egen restaurant, Tango.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Charter-Svein er tilbake, og med seg på lasset har han sine tre like energiske barn Noah, Liam og Ylva. Roger drar til havs for å fiske hai og har en opplevelsesrik tur på sjøen.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Buskeruddamene har landet og er klare for irish og strawberry. De må bare få permobil-lappen først. Det er onkel Erlings drømmedag og han har planlagt aktiviteter for gjengen de sikkert vil elske.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1305
programme.desc: Haider tar gladelig på seg rollen som Baywatch-stjerne da familien trenger opplæring i livredning. Rockeren Geir vil gjengjelde Fred Åges godhet og har planlagt en dag full av gaver og overraskelser.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1306
programme.desc: På Gran Canaria tar kjærligheten, vennskapet og små hverdagsdramaer uventede vendinger. Haider håper på en romantisk date med Neelam, Pondern og Mutza sliter med å mestre en nøkkelboks.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Roger våkner etter mareritt og må vaske klær etter noen hete og svette dager på øya. Pondern og Mutza setter i gang fyllestream med utfordringer, og Buskerud-gjengen legger ut på delfinsafari.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Roger er tilbake på Gran Canaria etter en litt strevsom tur, og på hotellrommet oppstår det problemer med lysbryteren i år igjen. Familien Haider gjør comeback, men får en slitsom ankomst.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 307
programme.desc: I Tydal finnes kanskje Norges yngste hytteeier, hun er 19 år! Guttas oppdrag blir derfor å lage en feminin, ungdommelig hytte som passer en ung kvinne og hennes venninner.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 309
programme.desc: Oppussingskvartetten dra til nydelige Kinn i Sogn og fjordane, hvor et fiskevær skal få en ny drakt. til nydelige Kinn i Sogn og fjordane, hvor et fiskevær skal få en ny drakt.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 206
programme.desc: Med Gudbrandsdalens fineste utsikt, skal Halvor og gutta sørge for praktiske og funksjonelle løsninger for familiehytta.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 406
programme.desc: En kort båttur utenfor Kristiansand finner gutta ei lita perle av ei hytte, hvor vinden kan blåse hatten din over til Danmark. Ole lanserer en helt spesiell utvendig kledning på dette bygget.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 508
programme.desc: Kalde netter i lavvo og et iskaldt bad under isen er noe av hva du kan se fra Skogn i Trøndelag. En gammel folkehøyskolehytte blir omgjort til familiehytte, og gutta gjør en drastisk omrokkering.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 102
programme.desc: Interiørdesigner Halvor drar på tur til Finnskogen, med de nevedyktige kameratene Mikkel, Gustav og Thomas, for å pusse opp en hytte på Jævelodden.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har kjøpt og solgt over 100 biler de siste 13 årene, og eiendommen hans er full av ulike kjøretøy. Selvom Ørjan tjener godt så bruker han langt over evne, og når kontoen er tom lever han på kreditt.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2502

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2503

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2504

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2505

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2506

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Phoenix Lights

programme.title: Aliens Among Us: The Michael Wolf Theory
programme.desc: Michael K. Wolf deler 30 års innsikt om UFOer, romvesener, statlige prosjekter og kornsirkler. Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Call
programme.desc: A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trance
programme.desc: A scam artist purports to channel the spirit of Delos, a former inhabitant of Atlantis. Together with a partner, he makes a living off of it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programme.desc: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programme.desc: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Passersby
programme.desc: On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror
programme.desc: After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Grave
programme.desc: Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programme.desc: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Madness Room
programme.desc: Cathy Osborne brings her husband up to a previously-unknown room in their house and along with her friend Michael, relates the tale of how the room is the "madness room" from which no one has ever stayed the night...and survived.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: If The Shoes Fit...
programme.desc: A fast-talking politician named Bo Gumbs who’s running for Governor. He learns his true colors while staying at a hotel for a meeting.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Levitation
programme.desc: A teenager enraptured with magicians goes to a flee-bitten circus to seek out one of the greatest ever: Kharma. However, Kharma now does cheap magic for the crowds, and none of the great illusions the teenager believed he was capable of.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: It All Comes Out In The Wash
programme.desc: Carl Gropper, a greedy developer, stumbles upon a Chinese laundry that offers a unique service - it can "wash out" guilt. Carl employs their services but soon finds there is an unpleasant price to pay.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Bigalow'S Last Smoke
programme.desc: Mr. Bigalow, a lifelong cigarette smoker, wakes up to find that his windows have bars on them and his door is sealed shut. A mysterious figure appears on Bigalow's television, informing him that he will quit smoking.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The False Prophet
programme.desc: Cassie Pines is a woman traveling on her own who believes in astrology, tea leaves...e everything. She comes into a diner with a most unusual mechanical fortune teller named Horace X.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Impressionist
programme.desc: An impressionist, "Mr. Personalities," is brought in by the government to try to help them communicate with an alien. Mr. Personalities is at first stumped but finally makes "contact."

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Lifebomb
programme.desc: Ben Martin, a rich businessman, is contacted by a special medical firm, "Lifebomb" which offers him an expensive policy that will let him live forever. They give him an implanted device which, every time he "dies," activates.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Ring Around The Redhead
programme.desc: As Billy is waiting to be executed in the electric chair, he relates the bizarre tale of how he came to be in his predicament at the hands of an attractive woman.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Parlour Floor Front
programme.desc: A woman becomes concerned when she discovers that a man that she and her husband rent a room to has been practicing voodoo. Although the man is good intentioned and kind, the woman regards him as a threatening and undesirable tenant.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 115

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 116
programme.desc: Da en nabo plutselig dør jobber Harry for hardt og havner under en traktor. Med døden i øynene fortsetter Harry å sette sønnene opp mot hverandre. Tess får høre en sjokkerende hemmelighet fra Liz.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 117
programme.desc: En fest ender nesten i en katastrofe når planene om å stoppe Brians ugjerninger slår feil.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 118

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 119

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1105

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1106

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1107
programme.desc: En gjeng gourmetkokker møter en gjeng fryktløse fartsfantomer. Christer Rødseth, Christoffer Davidsen og Trond Moi møter rallyfører Mads Østberg, artist Raylee og snøscooterkjører Marie Sandberg.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Det er klart for en intens og spektakulær kamp med Kristin Gjelsvik, Dennis Poppe og Oskar Westerlin på det røde laget, mot Herman Dahl, Emilie "Emzia" Helgesen og Christopher Robin Omdahl på det blå laget.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største drittsekk
programme.desc: Cartman føler seg ikke bra etter å ha drukket Kennys aske og blitt besatt av sjelen hans, og sendes til sykehuset.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny utvikler en dødelig sykdom, og Stan har problemer med å takle det.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Dilla på apefonetikk
programme.desc: Guttene konkurrerer mot hjemmeunderviste barn i South Parks årlige stavekonkurranse.

programme.title: South Park: Bestevenner for alltid
programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 7
programme.desc: Lewis Hamilton besøker Top Gear-banen, og Jeremy og James besøker National Motor Museum for å finne den virkelige opprinnelsen til den moderne bilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Teamet prøver å krysse den engelske kanal i amfibiebiler, tester en Porsche 911 mot en Audi R8, og Jools Holland er ukens gjest.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: I USA setter Top Gear-gutta kursen mot grensen til Mexico i en Lexus LFA, en Dodge Viper og en Aston Martin Vanquish.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James prøver å redde planeten ved å kjøpe hver sin elektriske bil.

programme.desc: Jeremy får hjelp av noen kjendisvenner til å teste den nye Kia Cee'd, og F1-stjernen Lewis Hamilton er ukens kjendis i en billigbil.

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Frenzied Killing
programme.desc: Flere mennesker blir drept i 1944 enn noen gang før på Auschwitz. Nazistene prøver å så forvirring blant de allierte i øst, og de vestlige allierte tar beslutninger om å forhandle med nazistene om jødene og bombe leiren.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Gathering Storm
programme.desc: The activities of nations after World War I that lead to World War II.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Beverly Johnson, Charlene Tilton, Jimmy Wayne
programme.desc: After the loss of her true love, Beverly is tormented by evil spirits bent on her destruction. Charlene purchases a home haunted by a murdered woman who frightens her.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mariel Hemingway, Kevin Brown, Curtis Armstrong
programme.desc: A deadly presence inhabits Mariel's home, threatening her very existence; Kevin nearly perishes in a deadly fire when his life is saved by someone from the other side.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Rivers, David Carradine, Scott Baio, Teri Polo
programme.desc: Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Barry Williams, Debi Mazar, Greg Grunberg, Sammy Hagar
programme.desc: When Barry Williams holds a memorial service for his father, a few strange "happenings" make the day even more unforgettable; Debi Mazer gets a hostile welcome from a ghost when she moves into a friend's home.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Patrick Muldoon
programme.desc: Patrick Muldoon (Melrose Place, Starship Troopers) faces his worst fears when he revisits an Inn in Charleston, SC, where he was once attacked by an evil entity.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Vince Neil
programme.desc: Vince Neil returns to the home where he last came into contact with the spirit of his four-year old daughter. The journey becomes an emotional roller coaster as Kim Russo discovers Vince is being followed by a dark energy.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Carole Radziwill
programme.desc: Author, journalist and Real Housewife Carole Radziwill returns to the Hamptons, New York beach home where she once encountered a ghostly presence.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Charles Schaughnessy
programme.desc: Charles Shaughnessy (The Nanny / Days of Our Lives) stands up to his boyhood fears and returns to a legendary 16th century English castle where he had a supernatural experience.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Broadwell Funeral Home
programme.desc: Nick attempts to communicate with two men who died in the Broadwell Funeral Home in Ohio.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Given the house's history steeped in trauma,Bihl Manor is believed to harbor a potent mix of positive and negative energies.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gjernforeningsfinalen
programme.desc: Siste fest i Geordie Shore-huset runder av gjenforeningen. Gjengen forbereder seg på å ta farvel, men blir det som venner eller må stadig tidligere konflikter diskuteres?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordierne er tilbake!
programme.desc: Geordierne er tilbake! Marnie Simpson planlegegr drømmebryllupet. Charlotte Crosby, Holly Hagan og Sophie Kasaei kommer à jour med graviditet, foreldreskap og nye kjærester. Sophie vil vite om hun skal være brudepike under Marnies store dag.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Den store dagen!
programme.desc: Marnie Simpson og Casey Johnson smis i hymens lenker! Alt ved dagen er ikke perfekt. De avslører problem med en felles bryllupsgjest, Charlotte. Hva vil skje når alle treffes under familiens hvetebrødsdager på Kypros?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Grunnregler
programme.desc: Charlotte og typen, Jake, kjemper med rot og bråk i familiens villa. Da Marnie avslører at Jake har vært høylydt mot sønnen, Rox, blir tingene vemmelige.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Mødre i krig!
programme.desc: Geordierne drar til dyreparken for å more seg, men dagen slutter i katastrofe. Da rotet hjemme blir for mye for visse, utbryter en krangel som ryster gjengen i grunnvollene.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: A Challenge to the World!
programme.desc: If Inazuma National want to play at the Football Frontier International, they should win the regional qualifiers. Their first rival are "Big Waves", Australia National Team, a team which plays as easy as a fish swims…

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Ride Over the Big Wave!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Scorching Hot Fight with the Desert Lions!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Sleeping Tiger Awakes!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Mark vs. Archer!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Possible Substitution?

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Coach Travis VS Coach Lina
programme.desc: Neo National Team are set to take Inazuma National place, and its players´ spirit put Inazuma National's in a predicament.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Cammy's Ultimate trick Strategy!
programme.desc: Mark is worried because he needs a new Super-Technique and he cannot come into anything. Cammy is worried over Mark's concern. And Sue will exploit both worries to made up a story that it will lead to the strangest date in history...

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Axel's decision
programme.desc: Asian qualifiers´ final is getting near, the whole team is getting ready for this final challenge and new Super-Techniques are being developed to fight their rivals.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The last match
programme.desc: After his father refusal, Axel agrees to drop football as soon as qualifiers are over.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Snow
programme.desc: The man who killed Catherine and took her baby sends an assassin to get Vincent. He manages to find the underground world and goes looking for him.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Beggar's Comet
programme.desc: Not wanting to put the Tunnel World in further danger, Vincent decides to leave the tunnels and with the death of Snow, Gabriel plots for Vincent's demise.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Time to Heal
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the boat explosion that most likely killed Elliot, Diana is shocked when she encounters a wounded Vincent who collapses on Catherine's grave.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Chimes at Midnight
programme.desc: After Vincent entrusts Snow's ring to Diana, she quickly discovers Gabriel's henchman have targeted her and soon kidnap her and take her to Gabriel.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Invictus
programme.desc: With Vincent caged, Gabriel allows him to see his infant son who suddenly begins to make a miraculous recovery.

programme.title: JAG: The Mission
programme.desc: A spotter on the ground calls for an airstrike as he has identified 15 heavily armed suspected Al Qaeda members on horseback. JAG won’t approve the airstrike until the spotter is absolutely certain the men are Al Qaeda members.

programme.title: JAG: Defending His Honor
programme.desc: An ambulance pulls up to a crash site where a woman, Jennifer Wilson, is found injured and crying for her baby. Unbeknownst to her, the six-month-old baby died in the accident. A Navy judge stands accused of vehicular homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Country
programme.desc: Central Command coordinates an airstrike on a confirmed target traveling through Afghanistan. After the strike is launched, marine troops assess the damage and they are disturbed to learn that they targeted the wrong vehicle and hit civilians instead.

programme.title: JAG: Enemy Below
programme.desc: Kabir is preparing an attack against the U.S. and was last seen crossing the border from Afghanistan to Iran. He is believed to have recruited Capt. Yerastov, a Russian submarine captain. Turner, Harm and Mac help in the hunt for the terrorists.

programme.title: JAG: Critical Condition
programme.desc: Bud has lost his right lower leg due to a mine in Afghanistan; during emergency surgery he faces bad trouble. Sturgis returns to Washington, and Harm and Mac disobey an order from the admiral. Bud encounters an astounding change of course.

programme.title: JAG: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff dies while chasing a car carrying two SEALs in a Navy exercise. The driver stands trial for negligent homicide.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Love Boat - The World's Greatest Kisser/ Don'T Take My Wife, Please/ The Reluctant Father
programme.desc: A jilted fiance hires a Mata Hari (Elaine Joyce) to find the crew member that ruined his wedding plans; a junior executive (Parker Stevenson) suffers in silence while his boss (David Doyle) lusts after his bride.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Affair On Demand/ Friend Of The Family/ Just Another Pretty Face
programme.desc: A married couple finds out that their daughter is in love with the father's best friend, while a progressive woman agrees to help her romantic partner have an affair.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Rhino Of The Year/ One Last Time/ For Love Or Money
programme.desc: When an organization wants to give a crew member an award, Captain Stubing suggests Isaac. Meanwhile, a fun-loving guy tries to help out his heartbroken friend but finds himself in trouble after meeting an unusual woman.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Bricker's Boy/ Lotions Of Love/ The Hustlers
programme.desc: The professional escort of an older woman (Vera Miles) dallies with a young woman (Constance Forslund); an advertising whiz tries to impress his best client despite putdowns from her daughter.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Misunderstanding/ Love Below Decks/ The End Is Near
programme.desc: An estranged mother and daughter mend their relationship after a secret about their past is revealed. Then, an attractive widow finds herself falling for a burly crew member.

programme.title: Wings: Come Fly With Me

programme.title: Wings: Happy Holidays
programme.desc: The holiday season always has its ups and downs and this year at Tom Never's Field is no exception. Brian and Alex lock horns because he doesn't want to spend Christmas with her whole family in Florida.

programme.title: Wings: Oh, Give Me A Home Where The Mather's Don't Roam
programme.desc: Lowell's constant mothering and annoying nagging is finally too much for Joe and Brian and they tell him it's time to move out. With his feelings hurt and scared to live alone, Lowell begins to sleep at the airport.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Were You Ever Even Pregnant?
programme.desc: Kaliegh is 23 but has been a heroin addict for five years. Her mom, best friend, and ex-boyfriend who got her hooked on heroin are here to beg her to go to rehab. Follow her as she travels to the rehab clinic and tries to get clean!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Forbidden Love
programme.desc: At twelve, Crystal dated 20-year-old Matt and was pregnant at 13. He served 15 months for sexual assault on a minor and is a registered sex offender. Is this inappropriate love or a misunderstanding?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 16-Year-Old Surrogate Stole Our Baby
programme.desc: Sarah was Dawn and Derek's surrogate, but took off while five months pregnant. Sarah claims that they took advantage of her. Who are the baby's rightful parents?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She's a Crazy Stalker
programme.desc: Victor met Jasmine a few years ago but claimed they never had sex. Jasmine claims that they fell in love and want him back! Who's telling the truth?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: These DNA Results Will Floor You
programme.desc: Joe met “Jessica” on a phone chat line. A few months later, she revealed she was pregnant. Then, Chastity claims that her ex Trent fathered her child. What will the DNA results reveal?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
programme.desc: Chelse claims that her 19-month-old daughter is Malcolm's and that he beat her while pregnant. Amber and Phillip accuse each other of being abusive and want the polygraph tests to prove their claims!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fall From Grace
programme.desc: Hikers come across a horrific scene: the corpse of a man left nude, beaten and bound in the mountain wilderness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: With Friends Like This
programme.desc: A young man is found gunned down outside his home. Sgt. Joe Kenda and Det. John Anderson must determine whether the killer was a complete stranger, a barrio gang member, or a jealous lover.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: .357 Magnum
programme.desc: The murder of a popular teen at a crowded house party sends Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection, and innuendo.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 505

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Papegøye / Valpene Redder Dronningbien
programme.desc: PAW Patrol drar ut i jungelen for å hjelpe vennen Carlos med å finne papegøyen Mateo som har blitt borte. // Ryder og PAW Patrol må hjelpe Cap'N Turbot å flytte bikubene over til et sted som er trygger for dem.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Voff og Roll-showet / Valpene Redder en ørn
programme.desc: Når en stor pop-stjerne kommer til byen, ødelegger en storm hele byen og scenen. Klarer Paw Patrol å redde dagen? // Mens de er i skogen redder valpene en ørn som sitter fast i reiret sitt.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder dykkerklokka / Valpene redder beverne
programme.desc: Mens Turbotene dykker, blir en av dykkerklokkene sittende fast. PAW Patrol må redde dem! // En storm vasker vekk beverdammen, så han tygger opp hele skogen til farmer Yumi. PAW Patrol kommer for å hjemmelaget ham med å bygge et nytt hus.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Talentshow / Valpene Redder Maisfesten
programme.desc: Det er dagen for Adventure Bukta's Talentshow ! Ordfører Goodway er spent, men redd det ikke vil være nok fremføringer! // Ryder og Pups hjelper Farmer Al å forberede den årlige Maiskolbe-stekingen som blir komplett med en Maiskolbe-labyrint!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Romvesen / Valpene Redder en Flyvefrosk
programme.desc: Et romskip krasjlander hos Farmer Yumi! // Nå er det opp til PAW Patrol å hjelpe romvesenet ved å fikse skipet hans og få ham tilbake til hjemplaneten sin!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Jake / Valpene Redder Paraden
programme.desc: Jake og Chase er dypt inne i en hule når Jake klarer å sette fast ankelen mellom noen steiner // Adventure Bukta's Paradedag går galt når Alex fester for mange ballonger på badekar-flåten til Katie. Den bokstavelig talt 'flyter' bort!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Ordfører-konkurransen / Valpene Redder Tyvegodset
programme.desc: Det er det årlige ordfører-racet og Ordfører Humdinger legger planer for den verste juksingen noensinne // Når Ryder kommer over et gammelt skattekart, stjeler Ordfører Humdinger kartet for å finne skatten selv.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Grynterne / Valpene og Spøkelseshytta
programme.desc: En sykedag hos Paw Patrol? Mens Rubbel og Ryder leter etter grisene til Al, må Marshall passe på de snufsete valpene // Først forsvinner lunchen til Rubbel, så er lunch-boksen til Jake borte. Er det et spøkelse?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Bjeffer med Dinosaurer
programme.desc: Valpene er på en utgraving når de graver ut tre fossile egg. Plutselig begynner eggene å klekke og snart er det tre pterodactyler som løper rundt i Adventure Bukta. Nå er det opp til Paw Patrol å fange dinosaurene.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Spøkelse / Valpene Redder en Forestilling
programme.desc: Et mystisk spøkelse forårsaker kaos om natten. Valpene og Chase sitter på vakt for å fange det, men oppdager at det ikke er et spøkelse i det hele tatt. // Valpene skal sette opp på et Middelalderskuespill i bytorget, men så kollapser scenen.

programme.title: iCarly: Utestengt
programme.desc: Når Carly bannlyser T-Bo fra hennes og Spencers hjem, hevner han seg ved å ikke slippe Carly inn på Groovy Smoothie. Imens oppdager Freddie og Gibby at det fins mange fordeler ved å spille i band...og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Las Vegas
programme.desc: Når Sam får vite at moren hennes er i fengsel i Vegas, bestemmer gjengen seg for å ta sine mest verdifulle eiendeler, kjøre til Vegas og pantsette dem - så de får nok penger til å betale borgen for henne. Gjesteartister: History Channels PAWN STARS.

programme.title: iCarly: Nattsynbrillene
programme.desc: Sams venn kommer ut av ungdomsfengselet, og Sam advarer alle om å holde seg unna, men Carly hører ikke etter og havner på dypt vann. Hjemme i leiligheten finner Spencer noen nattsynbriller.

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 1

programme.title: iCarly: Den stjålne laptoppen
programme.desc: Når Sams laptop blir stjålet, prøver iCarly-gjengen å hjelpe henne med å oppspore tyven. Imens får Spencer vite at han ikke får komme inn i sin yndlingsspillehall hvis han ikke er i følge med et barn. Hellet snur når Guppy trenger barnevakt.

programme.title: iCarly: Farvel del 2

programme.title: iCarly: Vårt eget webshow

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg vil ha flere seere

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1720

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1723

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1724

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 226

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 227

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 228

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 229

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 230
programme.desc: Det er andre dagen i finaleuken og Kjartan vil sette deltakernes smaksprøver på prøve. I dag handler det om å bruke sansene og ferdighetene sine for å samle poeng.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 231
programme.desc: Det er den nest siste dagen på Camp kulinaris! Én deltaker skal forlate konkurransen og det er flere som føler seg utsatt.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1302

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Underground Alien Bases
programme.desc: It could be one of the darkest and most sinister secrets in the entire field of UFO investigation: human-alien genetic experiments.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: USOs
programme.desc: In 1990 a pilot flying his small plane off Catalina Island spotted an object just below the surface of the water.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programme.desc: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programme.desc: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programme.desc: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Cold Equations
programme.desc: A rescue pilot on the frontiers of space is faced with unpleasant prospects when he finds an innocent stowaway on his ship.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: It's a Good Life
programme.desc: Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Deaths-Head Revisited
programme.desc: A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun
programme.desc: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
programme.desc: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Street of Shadows
programme.desc: While taking a walk in a wealthy neighborhood, an unemployed man living in a shelter experiences an unusual transformation

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Parlour Floor Front
programme.desc: A woman becomes concerned when she discovers that a man that she and her husband rent a room to has been practicing voodoo. Although the man is good intentioned and kind, the woman regards him as a threatening and undesirable tenant.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Halloween Candy
programme.desc: A mean old man harboring an intense hatred for the celebration of Halloween is left alone by his son to hand out candy to the neighborhood children.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Satanic Piano
programme.desc: Pete Bancroft is a talented pianist who has lost his inspiration, but is contacted by a mysterious inventor who gives him a piano that lets him play as never before simply by thinking of the music. Bancroft is at first relieved.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Devil'S Advocate
programme.desc: A hate-style radio host, Mandrake, spews out venom at anyone who calls in. He soon discovers, however, after receiving calls across all of time that he is dead but that the "Boss," has kept him on.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Distant Signals
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Trouble With Mary Jane
programme.desc: Two occultists are offered $50,000 if they can rid a girl of the multiple demons possessing her, but they soon find themselves in over their heads.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Ursa Minor
programme.desc: When Joan finds a new teddy bear in her daughter's room no one seems to know where it came from. Then night after night huge claw marks are found on the walls and the sounds of something very large can be heard moving through the house.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Effect And Cause
programme.desc: An artist named Kate discovers that she under unknown circumstances, has the psychic ability to live backwards, but things soon turn out for the worse when she realizes it's beyond her control.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Monsters In My Room
programme.desc: A little boy named Timmy tries to convince his mother and mean stepfather, that there are horrific creatures in his room, which includes a tentacled monster under his bed, a boogeyman, a saw, and a witch.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Comet Watch
programme.desc: Englebert Ames, an astronomer, is watching Hailey's Comet and is in for a shock when Sir Edmond Hailey himself arrives - he's been riding "his" comet all these years trying to elude Sarah, the woman pursuing him out of obsessed love.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 119
programme.desc: Kjærligheten ligger i luften i Drovers Run, også i hesteverdenen. Men i deres individuelle forfølgelse av ekte kjærlighet innser kvinnene at det er mange slag å vinne.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 120
programme.desc: Tess er besatt av sin psykologiteori og tror hun kan oppdage den virkelige grunnen til måten alle oppfører seg på.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 121
programme.desc: Når Tess' venner fra byen kommer på uventet besøk blir det tydelig at Tess' tidligere liv ikke kommer til å falme stille bort i det fjerne.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 122
programme.desc: Jodis innsamling til Miss Gungellan når nye høyder under en veldedighetskamp som skal holdes på Drovers Run, men en sky av misnøye skygger jentene når de gjør et makabert funn i dammen.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 201
programme.desc: Jodi strever mellom sannheten og Beckys følelser når hun innser at Seans besøk ikke er så uskyldig. Tess' hampavling holder henne borte fra Alex, mens Claires flørting med Peter tar en ny vending.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 202
programme.desc: Under en kaninpest dukker en baby opp på dørstokken til Alex. Peter og Claire sliter med å fornekte følelsene for hverandre.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Det er klart for en intens og spektakulær kamp med Kristin Gjelsvik, Dennis Poppe og Oskar Westerlin på det røde laget, mot Herman Dahl, Emilie "Emzia" Helgesen og Christopher Robin Omdahl på det blå laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Det er styrke, utholdenhet og akrobatikk som står i fokus når Anders Aukland, Martine Ek Hagen og Marthe Kristoffersen skal kjempe mot Lars Berger, Jonathan Nordbotten og Espen Jansen om den store gullskatten.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Dagens kamp står mellom Abu Hussain, Mayoo Indiran og Stian Sandø på det blå laget, og Alexandra Joner, Lene Orvik og Sebastian Solberg på det røde laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Det blir humor, spenning og høyt volum i dagens duell. Med Leif Einar "Lothepus" Lothe, Fetisha Williams og hennes far Byron Williams på det røde laget, og Fritjof Wilborn, Trude Mostue og Egil Andreas Skurdal på det blå laget.

programme.title: South Park: Bestevenner for alltid
programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: South Park: Midtbyen
programme.desc: South Parks bykjerne holder på å oppgraderes og Kenny bestemmer bestemmer seg for at det er på tide å skaffe en jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Den fattige ungen
programme.desc: Kennys foreldre blir arrestert og han plasseres i fosterhjem - så nå er Cartman det fattigste barnet på skolen! I mellomtiden kommer en mystisk figur fra fortiden tilbake.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen
programme.desc: Guttene bryter seg inn for å stjele urnen med Kennys aske.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy får hjelp av noen kjendisvenner til å teste den nye Kia Cee'd, og F1-stjernen Lewis Hamilton er ukens kjendis i en billigbil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Gutta tar en pause fra å sprenge campingvogner og drar på ferie, og Richard setter en lite imponerende verdensrekord i en F1-bil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Tom Cruise og Cameron Diaz er ukens kjendiser i en billigbil, og James May forsøker å slå sin egen fartsrekord i en Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Jeremy kjører den svenske superbilen Koenigsegg CCX, Richard tester den nye Nissan Micra-cabrioleten, og James prøver en ny Honda Civic.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson og James May ser nærmere på en stadig mer populær type høye småbiler som ofte kalles "crossover".

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Gathering Storm
programme.desc: The activities of nations after World War I that lead to World War II.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Corruption
programme.desc: I 1943 er korrupsjonen løpsk på Auschwitz-Birkenau. Leiren får også en ny inntektskilde – klær og verdifulle eiendeler tatt fra jøder som kommer for å bli gasset.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Patrick Muldoon
programme.desc: Patrick Muldoon (Melrose Place, Starship Troopers) faces his worst fears when he revisits an Inn in Charleston, SC, where he was once attacked by an evil entity.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Sally Struthers
programme.desc: Sally Struthers (All in the Family) shared her former home in Brentwood, CA with a ghost for many years. Traumatized by the experience, Sally returns with Kim.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Kim Carnes
programme.desc: Kim Carnes (Betty Davis Eyes) returns to her former residence a historic farmhouse in Franklin, TN, which she once shared with a childlike spirit.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: D.B. Sweeney
programme.desc: Actor D.B. Sweeney (Eight Men Out / Cutting Edge) comes back to the haunted motel in Fort Bragg, California where he had a terrifying experience with an evil entity.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 9
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Sue from Oxford whose house is overflowing with possessions. Sue married the love of her life in 2015, and he moved in, bringing everything he owned with him.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 10
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Linda and husband Andy from Bedau in South Wales whose house is overrun with animals and hasn’t been cleaned in 4 years.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Given the house's history steeped in trauma,Bihl Manor is believed to harbor a potent mix of positive and negative energies.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: North Eastern Hospital
programme.desc: Nick conducts a paranormal investigation in an abandoned hospital founded in the late 1800s.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Ernie Hudson
programme.desc: Beloved actor, Ernie Hudson returns to the remote mountain lodge in Arizona where he and his family encountered a terrifying supernatural force during the promotion of the original Ghostbusters movie.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Eric Mabius
programme.desc: For the first time in years, Eric Mabius (Resident Evil, Ugly Betty) returns to Allaire Village to confront the ghost.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Eric Roberts
programme.desc: Prolific film star, Eric Roberts almost lost his life in a tragic accident at the start of his career.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Connie Stevens
programme.desc: Connie and her daughter Joely Fisher have shared their home with a ghost for a long time. Kim accompanies both women.

programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
programme.desc: Chelse claims that her 19-month-old daughter is Malcolm's and that he beat her while pregnant. Amber and Phillip accuse each other of being abusive and want the polygraph tests to prove their claims!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?
programme.desc: Tasha wants to prove to her ex Martin that he fathered her four-year-old. Martin's sister says that the child might belong to her boyfriend Terrence. Who's the real father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Bullied Out of School
programme.desc: Aabrea and Jerae bullied a high school girl so badly that she dropped out. Can Steve help them resolve their differences and figure out why so many teens turn to bullying?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Extreme Deception Indicated
programme.desc: Joe and Tammy have been together for six years and they have two children. Joe faces cheating accusations again and returns to Steve's stage for his lie detector results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Think He's Gay
programme.desc: Monique’s friend claims that Adrian advertised himself on a “Gay for Pay” website. Then, pregnant Tyeasha suspects David of cheating on her with men. What will the polygraph say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Wouldn't Wish This on Anybody
programme.desc: On today's Steve Wilkos, will the lie detector results reveal if Tamisha and Simone's men were faithful? Or will it reveal some more sinister results?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: 15yr old Chuck returns home from school to find his mother, Betty Limbrick, shot dead on the floor. Evidence points to a robbery gone wrong, but Kenda uncovers a plot almost too shocking to believe.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Sisters
programme.desc: The bullet-ridden bodies of two sisters are found in a suburban house that’s littered with mysterious clues. Joe Kenda learns that the two unassuming young mothers shared an explosive secret.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Killer Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: When 22 year-old Micki Filmore is found raped and murder in her apartment, detective Kenda focuses his investigation on her activities the previous night.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: Flystyrtetterforskninger i Alaska: Tverrstopp over landeveien

programme.desc: Skarpskytterangrepene i Washington D.C. i 2002 presentert gjennom politiets og medienes redegjørelser.

programme.desc: Møt to førstedamer som steg ut av ektemennenes skygge og skapte sine egne store forandringer.

programme.title: CBS Morning News

programme.title: CBS Mornings

programme.title: CBS News 24/7

programme.title: Myth Hunters
programme.desc: In 1944 Italy, SS soldiers raid an Italian Count's villa under Himmler's orders to find the Germania, an ancient manuscript by Tacitus. Himmler idealized it as the "Book of Power" to prove Aryan superiority, justifying Nazi atrocities.

programme.title: Myth Hunters
programme.desc: California Gold Rush prospector goes in search of a legendary lost treasure ship in the Mojave Desert.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Thinker
programme.desc: Our brains are constantly aware of our place in reality. How does this work for animals? Does an objective reality even exist, and does it leave any room for something like god? Where will our thinking lead us?

programme.title: Wild Spain: The Mediterranean South
programme.desc: Even in the southern Spain, highly popular with holidaymakers, there is much waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Palacio Real, Madrid
programme.desc: From a clock that runs on witchcraft to a 21st Century king who outfoxes a fascist, discover the secrets inside the Palacio Real.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna
programme.desc: From the alchemy of turning silver into gold to a dance craze that changed history, discover the secrets inside the Kunsthistorisches Museum.

programme.title: On the Case: Silenced
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman goes missing, police are baffled.

programme.title: On the Case: Where Evil Lies

programme.title: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland

programme.title: On the Case: Unmistakable Truth
programme.desc: A family of three is murdered and investigators must take on one of their own in order to find justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Blurred Truth
programme.desc: Paula Zahn explores a chilling crime mystery involving a murdered mother of five and speaks to the individuals directly involved in the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Message In Blood

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dambusters

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Up, Gear Down
